identifiers.identifier_scope: Investigational radiopharmaceutical code for a lutetium-177-labeled small-molecule PSMA-targeted therapeutic candidate.

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: 177Lu HTK03170 is an investigational lutetium-177-labeled radioligand designed to bind prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA) on prostate cancer cells and deliver beta radiation to PSMA-expressing tumors.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Targeted binding to PSMA followed by tumor-localized beta-particle emission from lutetium-177, causing radiation-induced DNA damage and cancer cell death.
mechanism_of_action.selectivity: Designed to target PSMA-expressing tissue; quantitative selectivity versus non-target tissues not established in the retrieved human literature.

typical_use.histology: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (investigational context inferred from PSMA radioligand development program, but no verified human indication-specific trial record retrieved for this exact agent)
